dialogues.speaker: Kamla
dialogues.text: Oh, that bastard... Well... honestly, I don't know where he's sailing right now.

dialogues.speaker: Kamla
dialogues.text: Judging by what he'd sent home, he should be safe and well, and he's been to a lot of places.

dialogues.speaker: Kamla
dialogues.text: I've got clocks from Fontaine, porcelain bowls from Liyue, dried petals from Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Kamla
dialogues.text: I didn't know he could be romantic.

dialogues.speaker: Kamla
dialogues.text: But things like these can only be placed indoors. I prefer the fresh air and sea waves outside.
